headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense and Spencer Arrighetti pitching a strong 5.0 innings. The Cleveland Guardians shut down the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball and Kyle Manzardo leading the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the New York Yankees 4-2, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Carter Baumler (Texas Rangers), Jordan Hicks (Chicago White Sox), Mickey Moniak (Colorado Rockies), Jung Hoo Lee (San Francisco Giants), Burch Smith (Detroit Tigers), Ke'Bryan Hayes (Cincinnati Reds), Yoán Moncada (Los Angeles Angels), and Yusei Kikuchi (Los Angeles Angels). These players have been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations, the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, the Tampa Bay Rays trading LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays trading LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Cubs 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense and Spencer Arrighetti pitching a strong 5.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 11 batters and allowing no walks. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing a decisive victory. Yohendrick Piñango led the Pirates' offense with 1 hit and 2 RBI in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Down Rays in Scoreless Tie**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 0-0 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, marking a scoreless tie in the matchup.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out by Orioles in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 0-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, marking a hard-fought win for the home team. Burch Smith, a member of the Detroit Tigers, took the mound but ultimately fell short of securing a win for his team.

top_news.title: **Rangers RHP Carter Baumler Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Carter Baumler has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right intercostal strain. This move is effective as of today, May 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies on May 22, 2026, in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
